title: HOMFLY parabolic restriction, defect skein theory and the Turaev coproduct
summary: We define a HOMFLY version of the category $\text{Rep}_q\text{P}$ of quantum representations of a parabolic subgroup $\text{P}\subseteq\text{GL}_{m+n}$ of block triangular matrices. Alongside this category, we construct functors that interpolate the usual restriction functors between $\text{GL}_{m+n}$, $\text{P}$ and the subgroup $\text{L}\subseteq\text{GL}_{m+n}$ of block-diagonal matrices, yielding a universal version of the formalism of parabolic restriction.
